finding.text: At phone width the watch page's note and the one step it shows disagree (requirements 4, "get it by clicking") — shots/5-steps-400.png, band 2: the note says "Both views of apple change…" (step 5, just run) but the only step shown is 6, `root.set({ title: "Weekly shop" })`, because `.is-focus` marks the *next* step. Show the step that just ran (or both) below 70em.

`ux/Content/Object/doc/shape.md` is stale: it still describes the old `object()` card (header from `name`/`path`/`url`, a methods list, "the class is Object.js"). `page.js` still lists it in `notes: "shape default-view"`, and the readme no longer links it. Mark it superseded, fold it into default-view.md, or drop it from `notes`.

Stale comments in callers that now get the default view: `ux/Dictate/playground/objects.js:9` cites `Object.js`'s `icon_name()`, which is gone; `ai/classes/Session/SessionClassPage.js:2` loads "the card styles `inspect()` uses", which no longer apply. Repoint both to `DefaultView.js`.

The empty state is blank (requirements 4): before step 1, "The objects, live" and "Lines written" have nothing under them at every width (shots/…-core-Item-watch/1920.png, band 2; sheet.png). One muted line ("Press Next step to make the first object") would fill it.
Log group headers count the "no line written" note as a line: step 1 reads "1 line · 0 ms" over "no line written" (shots/9-all-1920.png, right column, first card). The same happens on step 4.

At 1200 the three columns are about 290px each (shots/…-Item-watch/1200.png): every step's code wraps to 2–3 lines, and the four buttons wrap to two rows (also at 1920). Below about 90em, a two-column grid (steps | objects, with lines under them) would read better.

On the Object page the open `Page` class view is a wall of about 20 field names plus 34 methods (shots/…-ux-Content-Object/1920.png, right column), while the App and This-page columns end at about 480px. Open it with `properties`/`method_names` capped, or closed. The App row's name is empty: it has only `{}` and the "App" label.

The fence and coupling: build B edited `core/Item/Item.js` (2-line `views` getter; the decision is logged in session.jsonl). `ScratchStore` overrides Store's private `_queue`/`_flushing`, and the core test `DefaultView.test.js` imports the demo's `core/Item/watch/Box.js`. Build A may change any of these, so expect a merge conflict.

A view built and never attached stays in `item.views` forever (it is only dropped once it was seen connected). This is documented in the readme's Watch out, but it is a slow leak for views built off-screen.

Show the class and its live instances: Box instances are on the watch page, but no page lists live DefaultView instances or an item's `views`. Low priority: a DefaultView holds little state the owner would watch.
